text:
Done — I refreshed the UI and split the front-end logic into smaller files without changing app behavior.

What changed:
- Gave the app a more modern look with:
  - softer gradients and glassy cards
  - cleaner spacing and rounded corners
  - updated button, badge, modal, and form styling
  - improved mobile responsiveness
- Split browser JS into smaller modules:
  - `public/js/ui.js` for shared UI helpers
  - `public/js/app.js` for dashboard/task logic
  - `public/js/auth.js` for login/signup/logout logic
- Simplified and cleaned up the HTML pages a bit to match the new styling and new script structure.

I also ran the test suite to confirm nothing broke.
